statement: Gigli’s characterization of Alexandrov curvature. Proves Gigli's conjecture: in every integer dimension n ≥ 2, Alexandrov curvature at least κ is characterized by the full-support $`\mathop{\mathrm{RCD}}\nolimits ((n-1)\kappa,n)`$ condition with reference measure $`\mathcal H^n`$ and distributional sectional curvature at least κ in the original global test classes. The RCD condition is unreduced.
